notes: PG-069 Accounts List RECONCILIATION. The feature shipped on main (IFC-273 bc8b1afac #415); this task corrects CSV artifact drift (account-list.tsx/hierarchy-view.tsx never existed -> AccountsPageClient.tsx/AccountHierarchy.tsx), produces the missing spec/plan/exec/attestation evidence, and closes the one genuine gap surfaced by the Plan-Reviewer: untested keyboard navigation in AccountHierarchy. Writing that regression test exposed a real production a11y defect (React onFocus bubbling collapsed keyboard focus onto the root treeitem, so arrow keys could not advance past the root); fixed with an e.target===e.currentTarget guard. All 5 mandatory validations pass; mandatory a11y-expert review PASS (0 blockers); two pre-existing should-fix roving-tabIndex items filed as fast-follow task_26d77df8. No shims, no renames, no false-path attestations, no fabricated Lighthouse score.
